title: UserProfile
description: A small, deliberately simple distilled standing profile -- not a log. Overwritten (not appended to) after each approved strategy via a reconciliation step that decides whether new information updates, merges with, or revises an existing note.

preferredPresentationDefaults.description: Widget size/theme leanings inferred from past configuration choices.

notes.description: Short natural-language distillations, e.g. 'tends to prefer compact widgets over sidebars'.
